P.name: Colossal Smash
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Galio's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and deal {{pplevel|15 to 115|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} to the target and all enemies near them.
P.description2: Whenever '''Galio''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} with an {{tip|ability}}, ''Colossal Smash's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 3 seconds. This may occur only once per cast.
P.description3: ''Colossal Smash's'' damage based on its {{as|AD ratio}} can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Galio|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage to all targets hit.

Q.name: Winds of War
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' creates two windblasts 250 units to either side of him that arc out before converging to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through.
Q.description2: When the blasts meet, the gusts form a tornado that persists for 2 seconds, slowly moving forward and dealing {{as|magic damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|2% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds|{{as|8% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}} over the duration}}to enemies within the area, capped at{{ft|150 per tick|600 total}}against {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Shield of Durand
W.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Galio''' gains ''Anti-Magic Bulwark'', and restores it after {{pp|12 to 8 for 3|1;6;11}} seconds without taking damage.

{{sbc|Anti-Magic Bulwark:}} Gain a {{tip|shield}} that absorbs {{as|magic damage}}.
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to 2 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} himself by 15%, and gaining {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage reduction; charging increases ''Shield of Durand's'' radius, damage and {{tip|taunt}} duration over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Physical Damage Reduction|{{ap|25/2 to 45/2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8/2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1/2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage Reduction|{{ap|25 to 45}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ 8% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description4: ''Shield of Durand'' can be recast within the duration and does so automatically afterwards or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
W.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Galio''' refreshes the [[damage modifier|damage reduction]] for 2 seconds and deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemy champions, increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|0 to 1.25|formula=100%+(25% per 0.16 seconds channeled).}}, as well as {{tip|taunt|taunts}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|0.5 to 1.5 for 9|0 to 1.25|formula=0.5+(0.125 per 0.16 seconds channeled).}} seconds and, after a brief delay, sets their {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} to a {{as|static 60|ms}} for the same duration but slightly longer.
W.leveling5: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 60*3}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
W.description6: '''''Galio''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to basic attack or cast abilities for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after the recast.''

E.name: Justice Punch
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' {{tip|lunge|steps back}} in the opposite direction over the cast time, then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location until he hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or [[terrain]].
E.description2: '''Galio''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through, reduced to 80% against non-champions, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds as well as {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for the same duration.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 240}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|100*0.8 to 240*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.8}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Hero's Entrance
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' prepares to make an entrance, {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.75}} seconds and designating the target allied {{tip|champion|champion's}} location at the time of cast as his landing spot. Additionally, he resets ''{{ais|Shield of Durand 2|Galio|Shield of Durand}}'' passive shield for himself and grants it to all allied champions within the area for 5 seconds.
R.description2: After channeling for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, he gains {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} for the remaining duration, becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, and leaps into the air for {{tt|{{fd|0.8 seconds}}|Estimated}} before {{tip|dash|dashing}} to his destination over {{tt|{{fd|0.2 seconds}}|Estimated}}. Afterwards, he lands and becomes targetable again, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon impact, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} 100 units over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, and remaining in place for {{tt|{{fd|0.5 seconds}}|Estimated}}.
